title: Protocol to evaluate the impact of murine MCT1-deficient CD8+ T cells on adipogenesis
protocol: Euthanize mouse with isoflurane (2%) or other approved methods.
Open the abdomen of the mice by using surgical scissors and tweezers.
Collect the two inguinal lymph nodes located in the subcutaneous adipose tissue of the inguinal left and right regions.
Collect brachial and axillary lymph nodes located in the axillary left and right regions.
Eliminate the surrounding adipose tissue from collected lymph nodes.
Place lymph nodes in a 48-well plate containing 500 μl of MACS buffer per well.
Open the peritoneal cavity and collect the spleen which is located inside the rib cage on the left, above the stomach.
Place the spleen in the 48-well plate containing 500 μl of MACS buffer previously used also for lymph nodes.
Prepare a uniform cell suspension of primary lymphocytes from the lymph nodes and spleen.
In a sterile biosafety cabinet, place a 70 μm cell strainer on top of a 50 ml tube.
Mash the lymph nodes and spleen through the strainer using a 1 mL syringe plunger and 10 mL MACS buffer.
Centrifuge the cells at 500 g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant with a vacuum.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of eBioscience™ 1X RBC Lysis Buffer.
Incubate the suspension at 4°C for 5 minutes.
Bring up the suspension to a volume of 10 mL using MACS buffer.
Centrifuge the suspension for 5 minutes at 500 g.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 10 mL of MACS buffer.
Count the cells in the counting chamber using a 1:20 dilution in Trypan blue.
Isolate CD8+ T lymphocytes with negative selection beads from the EasySep™ mouse CD8+ T cell isolation kit.
Centrifuge cells at 500 g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend cells in MACS buffer to achieve a concentration of 1×10^8 cells per mL.
Transfer samples into a 5 mL sterile polystyrene round bottom tube.
Add 50 μL/mL rat serum and 50 μL/mL isolation cocktail.
Mix briefly and incubate for 10 minutes at 22°C.
Vortex the beads vial for 10 seconds and add 125 μL/mL to each sample.
Vortex rapidly and leave the tubes for 5 minutes at 22°C.
Fill each tube with MACS buffer until reaching a volume of 2.5 mL.
Place the tube into the magnet and incubate for 2.5 minutes.
Pour the enriched cells by inverting the magnet and collect CD8+ T cells in a new 15 mL tube.
Count the enriched cells with Trypan Blue using a 1:10 dilution.
Resuspend the cells in RPMI-10 medium to achieve a cell concentration of 2×10^6 cells/mL.
CD8+ T cells are ready for activation.
Coat a 12-well plate with 500 μl per well anti-CD3 (0.5 μg/mL) and CD28 (2.5 μg/mL) diluted in PBS, for 1 h at 37°C.
Aspirate the coating.
Plate 2×10^6 of isolated CD8+ T lymphocytes in each well ensuring to reach a final volume of 2.5 mL of complete RPMI medium preheated at 37°C.
Add interleukin (IL)-2 at a concentration of 25 U/mL and leave the cells to be activated for 24 h at 37°C in the presence of 5% CO2.
Collect CD8+ T cells from the 12-well plate into a 15 mL tube after 24 h of incubation.
Add 1 ml of MACS buffer to the well and pipette again to be sure to collect all the cells.
Add 1 mL of PBS to the well to ensure all cells are collected before discarding the plate.
Check under the microscope for any remaining cells in the plate.
Pipette again if necessary and add the solution to the previously collected cells.
Centrifuge the 15 mL tube containing the cells at 500 g for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant from the centrifuged cell pellet.
Resuspend the pellet with MACS buffer.
Count the resuspended cells using Trypan Blue.
Centrifuge the 15 mL tube containing the counted cells at 500 g for 5 min.
Resuspend the counted cells in R10 complete medium to achieve a concentration of 2×10^6 cells per 1.5 mL.
Transfer 2×10^5 cells into a 96 well plate (V-bottom).
Centrifuge the plate at 800 g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet with 50 μL MACS buffer containing 0.5 μL of anti-CD69 antibody per well.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C in the dark.
Add 150 μL of MACS buffer to each well to wash the cells.
Centrifuge again at 800 g for 5 min.
Repeat steps “e” and “f” once more.
Resuspend each well with 100 μL of MACS buffer.
Transfer cells to a 5 mL tube.
Bring each sample to a final volume of 250 μL with MACS buffer.
Acquire the samples with the cytofluorimeter.
Compare median of the forward scatter between basal and activated cells.
Compare median of the side scatter between basal and activated cells.
Compare CD69 fluorescence intensity between basal and activated cells.
Mix 2×106 activated CD8+ T cells with transwell insert in each well of the 6-well plate.
Let co-culture grow for three days until day 9 (T9) of differentiation protocol.
Remove transwell inserts from wells.
Harvest cells from each well of the 6-well plate.
Extract RNA through a spin column isolation method.
Perform reverse transcription to synthesize cDNA.
Reverse transcribe 1 μg/μL of RNA using Maxima First Strand cDNA Synthesis Kit for RT-qPCR.
Perform qPCR analysis to evaluate gene expression involved in adipogenesis.
Use Cebpα, Cebpδ, Cidea, Glut4, Lep, Lpl, Ppar δ, Pparγ, and Ppargc1α as target genes.
Use RPL 13a as a housekeeping gene for normalization.
Prepare Maxima SYBR Green/Fluorescein qPCR Master Mix with final primer concentration of 300 nM.
Test primer efficiencies before performing the experiments.
Co-culture activated CD8+ T cells at day 6 of the differentiation protocol.
Evaluate the effect on the second phase of adipogenesis.
Study the expression of genes such as GLUT4 and LPL.
